exp1.description: Built the "AI Co-creation Community" from 0 to 1 to lower the barrier to AI adoption, completing product design, full-stack development, and MVP delivery in 30 days.
achievements: User Research & Product Design: Interviewed **30+** product, operations, engineering, and functional employees, identified high-frequency productivity scenarios, and led the Project Co-creation, Asset Repository, and Knowledge Sharing modules.

AI-Assisted Full-Stack Development: Used Cursor to independently complete front-end, back-end, and database deployment—bypassing traditional review and sprint cycles—and compressed the MVP timeline from months to **30** days.
Cold Start & Scaled Operations: Reached **2,000** internal users, converted **200** registrations, and incubated **41** projects, while packaging reusable Prompt templates and AI Coding practices.

exp3.description: Owned 0-to-1 product design and prototyping for Working Agent and Step Expert, covering a consumer delivery Agent and an internal expert data-authoring platform.
achievements: Working Agent: Designed an Agent for students, professionals, and creators that directly produces PPTs, spreadsheets, and documents; independently built an interactive desktop prototype and defined an MVP-to-segmented-growth path.
Skills library: Designed a preset-template-to-personal-skill workflow to help users save and reuse capabilities over time.

Step Expert: Turned abstract annotation workflows into a visual Select Skill → AI Generate → Expert Review flow; used AI Coding to build a high-fidelity prototype and detailed handoff documentation, driving the product to development launch.

exp2.description: Led product planning and operations for Yuanstore (次元市集), QQ’s IP merchandise marketplace for anime collectibles such as trading cards and pins.
achievements: B2B Supply Chain Overhaul: Redesigned the merchandising system to fix slow product listing. Built a batch upload feature and standardized SOPs, doubling listing efficiency (from **3** to **6** SKU sets/week, **+100%**) and directly driving weekly GMV up **25%**.

Merchandising & Catalog Expansion: Combined QQ in-app user data with external trend signals (e.g., Xiaohongshu) to design an IP heat evaluation framework for targeted high-potential IP discovery. Expanded the direct-supply catalog **4x** through procurement and B2B partnerships, resolving the platform’s core SKU gap.

Commercialization Campaigns: Built standardized campaign configuration templates (H5 templates & promo rules) to reduce ops overhead. Led multiple themed promotional campaigns, growing monthly GMV from **469K** to **811K** (**+73%**).

Customer Service System Upgrade: Designed a CS monitoring dashboard and alert system. Set KPIs including "30s response rate"; improved response rate from **40%** to **90%** and achieved zero complaints for the quarter.

proj3.name: Xiaohongshu AI Content Generator
proj3.oneLiner: A custom AI writing system for "你的AI背包", solving hallucination and style drift in generic AI tools
proj3.role: Product Design · Prompt Architecture · Content Operations
proj3.description: While running a Xiaohongshu account, I found generic AI content suffered from three problems: fabricated personal anecdotes, inconsistent tone, and ignored platform rules. Core approach: embed quality standards into the Prompt system so AI aligns at generation time, not through post-hoc editing.
highlights: Three-layer architecture: Anti-hallucination layer (user supplies context each time, eliminating fabrication), Style control layer (four content structure templates), Platform layer (title length limits, SEO keyword placement, mobile-friendly formatting)
Iterated from v1.0 to v2.0: data analysis of 5 posts revealed search keywords as the key traffic driver, leading to an SEO module and a 6-item post-generation checklist
Account built from zero — third post achieved **1,600+** saves and **1,000+** likes

proj4.name: Federated Boosting with Differential Privacy
proj4.oneLiner: HUST undergraduate thesis — collaborative model training without centralizing user data, balancing performance and privacy
proj4.description: Built on Shen et al. (2022)'s Federated Functional Gradient Boosting (FFGB) algorithm, extending it with a privacy protection mechanism. Clients train weak learners via residual tracking each round; the server aggregates them into a global model. An adaptive Gaussian noise mechanism dynamically adjusts noise intensity based on loss changes to balance privacy and accuracy.
highlights: Integrated Boosting into the federated framework with an adaptive Gaussian differential privacy mechanism that tunes noise strength dynamically
Applied knowledge distillation to compress the ensemble model and reduce client–server communication overhead
Validated across multiple datasets under high data heterogeneity: significantly faster convergence than FedAvg, with strong model accuracy retained after applying differential privacy
